def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):

def hperiod(grid):

import json
lib=open('programs/lib.py').read()
add='''
from collections import Counter

def blocks(grid):
    """Split the grid by its one-color frontier rows and columns into subgrid blocks."""
    fr=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1]
    fc=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({r[j] for r in grid})==1]
    def gs(fs,n):
        out=[];prev=-1
        for f in fs+[n]: out.append(list(range(prev+1,f))); prev=f
        return [g for g in out if g]
    return gs(fr,len(grid)),gs(fc,len(grid[0])),fr,fc

def block_marks(grid, threshold=2, mark=1):
    """Each block between frontiers becomes one cell: mark if it holds >=threshold cells of the minority non-frontier color, else the majority color."""
    rg,cg,fr,fc=blocks(grid)
    fcolors={grid[i][j] for i in fr for j in range(len(grid[0]))}|{grid[i][j] for j in fc for i in range(len(grid))}
    cells=[v for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(r) if i not in fr and j not in fc]
    bg=Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[mark if sum(1 for i in ri for j in ci if grid[i][j]!=bg and grid[i][j] not in fcolors)>=threshold else bg for ci in cg] for ri in rg]
'''
